_readme: The registry for the ajit-segment-bots blueprint. The diagram is drawn from
this file and nothing else. Nothing here is invented: categories and features
come from the user, and each carries the origin it came from.
THE RULE THAT KEEPS THE FLOW CLEAN AS PARTS ARE ADDED:
a feature never names another feature. It names only the data it consumes and
the data it produces. Two features are connected when, and only when, one
produces a data type the other consumes. A new part therefore cannot invent a
private wire to an old part -- it can only attach to data that already exists,
or declare new data of its own. Swap any part for a better one honouring the
same contract and nothing else in the system changes.
categories[]  the foundation blocks. Every feature belongs to exactly one.
data_types[]  id, name, description -- what actually moves between parts
features[]    id, name, role, category, consumes[], produces[], replaces?
features[] is empty until the user describes them. data_types[] is empty
until the flow between categories is declared. Neither is guessed.
